title: Office Battlefield - Better and Brighter Than Ever
summary: Two football jerseys once symbolized friendship and mutual respect. After the office conflict, Jason reads every attempt to reconnect as disrespect and insists that he can finally see clearly.

portal.scene: Jason walks toward a bright eye-shaped doorway between two exchanged football jerseys, while office conversations, gifts and missed connections fill the surrounding ring.
portal.motif: Seeing clearly or seeing what he expects

production_status: author-selected full manuscript and board-derived digital portal; print and media pending
